messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: chat/completions - prod - p99 latency crossed 3s for model=mistral-instruct (group: latency-high). Alert firing at 2026-03-15T14:12:15Z. Paging sam.
Sam (oncall): I'm on it. pulling up traces and recent deploys.
Caroline (sre): I see a correlated bump in request bursts around 14:05 UTC. p95 moved from ~450ms -> ~1.1s, p99 ~2.9s. Notable increase for route `/v1/chat/completions` with model=mistral-instruct and model=mistral-8k.
Sam (oncall): thanks. Is this global or specific region? any customer reports?
Diego (infra): mostly us-west-2 and eu-west-1. No broad error increase, just latency. No recent infra deploys in last 6h. I/O wait on a small subset of pods looks spiky.
Maria (prod-eng): Customer #ACME opened a support ticket referencing slow responses in their widget around 14:10. They included a sample: `POST /v1/chat/completions` payload small prompt -> latency 7s.
Caroline (sre): Running Prom query to see per-route p99

```
max by (route, model) (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model)))
```

Caroline (sre): Results: `route=/v1/chat/completions model=mistral-instruct p99=3.2s`, `model=mistral-8k p99=2.8s`, other models under 1s.
Sam (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce alert noise by splitting the alert to per-model thresholds so we can silence low-severity fires; 2) add a temporary suppression for models with <1% traffic; 3) scale up pool for mistral-instruct to see if capacity helps.
Diego (infra): I can spin up +20% pods in the mistral pool now. Triggering autoscale override for the pool: `rdctl pools scale --name mistral-prod --replicas 12`.
Sam (oncall): Doing that now. Also rolling back a risky client-side change? any recent model variant swaps?
Maria (prod-eng): No model swaps in last 24h. We did A/B prompt-change for a few customers but not ACME.
Caroline (sre): From traces, tail latency indicates KV cache misses concurrent with increased batch sizes. Likely candidate: batching heuristics misfired with sudden burst pattern. If we reduce max batch size for mistral to 32 -> should reduce queueing.
Sam (oncall): Can infra apply a kernel-level change to batching threshold? Who owns batching config?
Diego (infra): It's runtime config. I can push a temporary override via k/v config service: `redwood-config set runtime.batch.max_size.mistral-instruct 32 --env prod --note "temporary reduce p99 spike"`.
Sam (oncall): Please do that and confirm.
Diego (infra): Done. change id `cfg-20260315-01`. Observing metrics...
Grafana-bot: New alert evaluation: chat/completions p99 for mistral-instruct now at 1.2s (after scale+batch change). Noise should drop.
Sam (oncall): Good. Can we adjust alerts to be per-model thresholds? Current rule is global p99>2s which made it noisy when small-percentage models spike. Proposed: p99>2.5s for default, p99>2.0s for high-latency-prone models (mistral variants), and add per-route overrides for `/v1/chat/completions` to be more sensitive. Also add stable traffic filter: only fire if model traffic >1% of total over 10m.
Caroline (sre): Agree. I'll open a PR to alter the alerting rule. Draft query (Prometheus alert rule):

```
- alert: ChatCompletionsHighP99
  expr: |-
    (
      max by (model, route) (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model)))
    ) > (label_replace(
      vector(2.5), "model", "${1}", "model", ".*"
    ))
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "{{ $labels.route }} p99 high for model={{ $labels.model }}"
```

Caroline (sre): But I'll add a `and (sum by(model) (rate(http_requests_total[10m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[10m])) > 0.01)` clause to avoid firing on tiny-sample models.
Sam (oncall): Nice. Also add a dashboard panel that shows p95/p99 by model for chat routes and a small table for top-5 models by p99.
Maria (prod-eng): I can own the dashboard tile and the runbook note to include this mitigation step (reduce batch size, scale pool). I'll add the playbook entry: "temporary batch override and pool scale — check KV cache miss rate, then revert after 30m stability".
Diego (infra): Revert plan: remove override `redwood-config unset runtime.batch.max_size.mistral-instruct --env prod --note revert-after-stable` and scale down to baseline after 45m stable.
Sam (oncall): Tracking tasks: Caroline -> PR for alert rule (link when ready). Maria -> dashboard panel + runbook update. Diego -> verify autoscale logs and revert script. Sam -> follow up with ACME support and mark incident severity. We'll keep this thread for handoff.
Caroline (sre): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alerts/pull/421. Changes include per-model thresholds and traffic-floor. Requesting review from @sam and @diego.
Sam (oncall): Reviewing now.
Grafana-bot: Alert resolved: ChatCompletionsHighP99 for model=mistral-instruct at 2026-03-15T14:35:07Z. duration ~22m.
Sam (oncall): Marking incident as degraded (no customer outage) and will do final handoff to night oncall at 17:00 UTC. Will include runbook pointer and PR link in the handoff note.
Maria (prod-eng): Noted. Adding ACME ticket link and recommended client-side retries guidance.
Caroline (sre): Post-incident follow-ups: 1) make per-model alert defaults documented; 2) evaluate making KV cache pre-warm for mistral; 3) run synthetic load to replicate burst pattern.
Sam (oncall): Thanks team. I'll create the follow-up Jira and schedule an async postmortem. If anyone sees re-occurence ping this thread.
Diego (infra): Logs/trace snippets placed in the incident folder: s3://redwood-incidents/1763456789/ for postmortem. I'll attach the autoscale events.
Sam (oncall): Handoff: I'll add a final summary to #incidents and then close. :white_check_mark:"
